text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - model rollout in prod (svc-infer, us-east-1). Elevated decode errors and 5xxs. Paging @maria for on-call eng. :rotating_light:

maria: ack, looking now.

maria: quick summary: spike in decode anomalies at 12:03 UTC. Canary responses show garbled token sequences for standard prompts. Latency + error rate both up.

james: fyi I promoted release v2026.03.15 to canary earlier. Build artifact metadata shows weights digest mismatch: expected a1b2c3 but container has a1b2c4 - looks like wrong weight bundle shipped.

leo: how did the tag end up pointing to a different weightset? pipeline promotion uses tag "stable" -> checking registry.

maria: impact estimate: ~2% of requests returned malformed tokens, ~0.4% 500s. A few high-SLA customers saw truncated/garbled outputs. CS alerted.

sam: customer-reported logs: truncated completions and repeated token patterns. Can we route impacted customers to fallback model via feature flag?

james: two mitigation options: immediate rollback to roll-id 2026-03-14-2 OR flip weight routing flag to force pinned v2 weightset. Rollback preferred if routing could be sticky.

maria: executing kill-switch now to be safe:
```
/ops/feature-flags set --env prod certify_weightset_v3 false
```

incident-bot: Deploy bot: feature flag updated by maria at 12:10 UTC. Routing will fallback to pinned weightset v2 within ~30s.

leo: starting rollback of canary group in us-east-1 to previous artifact. Command issued:
```
deploy rollback --group=us-east-1 --to-tag=20260314-2 --force
```

maria: monitoring metrics: errors dropping, decode anomaly rate falling. Latency trending back to baseline (observed recovery ~90s after flag flip).

evan: note: KV cache warmup mismatch between weight versions observed; expect short transient 503s as nodes repopulate caches (30-120s window).

james: suspected root cause: artifact promotion used mutable tag. Race between weight packaging job and promotion allowed a newer weight bundle to be tagged as "stable". We'll enforce tag immutability and pin by content-digest in CI.

sam: CS update: top-3 affected customers contacted, routed to fallback where possible, monitoring for follow-ups. No SLA breach declared yet but we notified account teams.

productbot: Incident marked SEV1 and added to incident board: https://redwood/ops/incidents/4901234567

maria: handing off to oncall-next (leo) for post-incident RCA and follow-ups. I'll stay for verification.

leo: ack taking postmortem ownership. Please drop timeline, logs, and PR refs into the ticket.

james: opened PR to pin promotions to digest-based artifact references -> PR #1248 (will include tests for tag immutability).

maria: closing pager — final checks show errors back to normal and no active customer impact. :white_check_mark:
